title: Fix nullable BigInteger conditional type inference in the historical donor matcher
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Type of conditional expression cannot be determined because there is no implicit conversion between '<null>' and 'BigInteger'

scope.goal: Eliminate the reported conditional-expression compiler error in HistoricalGrossNetDonorMatcher.ValidateSharedSelection.
inScope: Solution-build and focused donor-matcher test verification of that type declaration.
outOfScope: Changing either conditional branch, donor matching, tier selection, hash calculation, accounting, persistence, service, database, or trading behavior.
Changing another product or test file, another compiler error, or existing warnings.
scope.periodOrFilter: not-applicable; this is a compile-time local type-inference correction with no data or time window
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the failing conditional, the SelectedTier declaration, all ValidateSharedSelection call sites, and the focused matcher tests to establish the required nullable target type.

requirements.text: Give expectedTierValue the explicit nullable BigInteger target type required by its null and BigInteger branches, without changing either branch or matcher behavior.
requirements.sourceQuote: there is no implicit conversion between '<null>' and 'BigInteger'
acceptanceCriteria: The declaration is exactly BigInteger? expectedTierValue while the expectedStrategyId condition, null branch, BigInteger construction, and comparison remain unchanged.
A null expectedStrategyId still requires a null SelectedTier; a non-null expectedStrategyId still requires the BigInteger representation of expectedTier.
The reported CS0173 conditional-expression compiler failure is absent from the solution build and focused HistoricalGrossNetDonorMatcher tests pass.
No product or test file other than src/PolyCopyTrader.Service/PaperTrading/HistoricalGrossNetDonorMatcher.cs is changed by this correction.

verification.command: Inspect HistoricalGrossNetDonorSelectionEvaluationV1.SelectedTier, every ValidateSharedSelection call site, and the focused task diff.
verification.expected: SelectedTier is BigInteger?, the null/non-null expectations are unchanged, and the focused diff changes only the local declaration type.

verification.command: dotnet build PolyCopyTrader.sln -c Debug --artifacts-path <marked D:\CodexTemp run artifacts path>
verification.expected: Build exits 0 without the reported CS0173 error; warnings are reported exactly.

verification.command: dotnet test tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests.csproj -c Debug --no-restore --filter FullyQualifiedName~HistoricalGrossNetDonorMatcherTests --artifacts-path <marked D:\CodexTemp run artifacts path> --results-directory <marked D:\CodexTemp run results path>
verification.expected: Focused HistoricalGrossNetDonorMatcher tests exit 0 with no failures.
